text:
maya: FYI pushed a docs PR that updates the migration guide + a couple SDK snippets. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482

sam: thanks — can you add reviewers? who owns migration guides now?

maya: adding @leo and @olivia as reviewers. main things: tone polish for migration section, clarify 'quantization profiles' terminology, and update python snippet in SDK section to use the new client config. small link fix too.

leo: scanning now. quick tone note: we prefer active voice and second person for how-to steps ("you"). also we use lowercase 'model' unless referring to a specific named model (e.g., "Redwood-1"). please run a quick search for capitalized "Model" in the doc.

olivia: will check the snippets. the python example currently uses the old `Client()` args. please switch to the new `RedwoodClient(config=...)` pattern and include a minimal `timeout` example. also prefer `snake_case` variable names in examples.

maya: got it — updated code block and lowered a few titles to sentence case. pushed a small commit (sha: a1b2c3f).

docs-ci: preview build started for PR #482 — docs-preview.redwood/team/482.

leo: small nit — in the migration checklist we say "ensure quantization is compatible" which is vague. suggest: "Verify the quantization profile supports the target GPU and test with a short eval set (see evals/quick-qa)."

maya: good suggestion, updated to exact wording and added link to evals. also fixed a dead anchor in the SDK reference that was breaking the preview.

docs-ci: docs-preview build failed — reason: broken anchor in /sdk/python#client-config-line. CI log: `ERROR: anchor not found: client-config-line`

maya: that was the dead anchor I just fixed in the same push, running another build.

docs-ci: docs-preview build passed — preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.dev/482 (screenshots attached).

olivia: snippet looks good now. one tiny style thing: wrap example argument names in backticks, e.g., `max_tokens=256` instead of plain numbers.

leo: I've done a quick read for tone and terminology. two small suggestions: change "the model will be quantized" -> "if you quantize the model, expect small accuracy differences" and replace "fallback to smaller model" with "fallback to a compatible, lower-capacity model". otherwise LGTM.

sam: do we have any docs freeze / release window today? want to coordinate merge time so we don't collide with runtime deploy at 14:00 PT.

maya: no freeze but good call — can we merge after 15:00 PT to be safe? I'll wait for approvals then.

leo: approve (quick) — leaving two tiny nits as comments, non-blocking.

olivia: approve.

sam: approve and will watch for merge at ~15:05 PT. also adding changelog note request: small migration guide tweak, nothing user-impacting.

docs-bot: Added label `docs/approved` to PR #482.

maya: thanks all — merging at 15:07 PT after a final smoke check of the preview.

maya: merged. PR #482 is now in `main`. thanks! :tada:

sam: nice, will kick off the post-merge smoke run.

docs-ci: post-merge site build started.

docs-ci: site build successful and published to https://docs.redwood.ai/migration/upgrade-guide#quantization-migration

olivia: quick follow-up: I dropped a tiny wording tweak in a separate PR (non-blocking).

maya: noted — will review. thanks everyone.
